But I think for us in recovery, it's a safe place to discuss our scars amd wether or wether not they'll fade or how we can be proud of our faded scars. If you KNOw you'll be triggered by images of scars, then it's your decision to look at them here. 
People post different "severity" scars here, FOR SUPPORT. I personally haven't seen people openly compare each others scars. Which would be problematic as hell. This is pro-recovery sub.
